scope: Future preparation only; no new API authorization and no changes to past trials
summary: 后续工作配置采用随机3/8/20篇新闻，保留50/50主题抽取。中心与个人误差有小幅收益，W1近乎不变；原预登记的分布改善筛选仍记为未通过。

news_quantity.assignment: Existing input-balanced random allocation; no demographic quantity weighting or target-based selection
news_quantity.future_sizes: Scale proportions with a deterministic remainder rule; freeze the rule and allocation seed before the next run

limits: Working adoption is not statistical confirmation or evidence of Pareto improvement
Center benefit differs across generations and periods; later four 2025 months do not improve on average
Only one allocation seed; no claim of measured individual news exposure
All-four complete-case reversal remains a missingness sensitivity check, not the direct two-arm estimate
Keep fixed_8 as a benchmark and evaluate the adopted configuration in the final frozen validation
